sulfurCube.assumptions.title: Scope and fixed assumptions
sulfurCube.assumptions.intro: This view keeps the following assumptions fixed:
sulfurCube.assumptions.call: An accepted primary player melee hit can add an ordinary launch step and, with sprinting or Knockback, one separate extra step.
sulfurCube.assumptions.cube: The adult sulfur cube starts at rest and uses its standard dimensions and the selected properties. The default state places its feet at (0, 0, 0).
sulfurCube.assumptions.aim: The aim point constructs the attacker's look direction; it is not a sampled collision point.
sulfurCube.assumptions.trajectory: The trajectory begins with the first cube movement update after the impulse and models repeated collision and rebound over the selected infinite, level, uniform floor. It includes source-ordered cutoff, friction, restitution, speed factor, gravity, air drag, and relevant floor callbacks. It excludes floor edges, gaps, walls, fluids, later attacks, honey side sliding, active explosive fuses, and other obstacles.
sulfurCube.invalidInputs: Check the highlighted inputs. Use finite values and a trajectory length from 0 to 6000 ticks.

sulfurCube.properties.title: Archetype
sulfurCube.properties.archetypeDefinitio: An archetype is a set of properties applied when the sulfur cube absorbs a matching block item. It determines launch power, resistance, air drag, and other behavior.
sulfurCube.properties.absorbedBlockHelp: Search through the 339 block items accepted by the sulfur cube.
sulfurCube.properties.blockResultsKeyboa: Use the arrow keys to move through the blocks, then press Enter or Space to select one.
sulfurCube.properties.blockNoResults: No absorbed blocks match this search and archetype filter.
sulfurCube.properties.customHelp: Custom values persist when you leave Custom mode or change the selected block or archetype.
sulfurCube.properties.customInvalid: Enter finite values, keep knockback resistance from −2 to 1, bounciness from 0 to 1, and the air-drag and friction modifiers from 0 to 2048.
sulfurCube.properties.lockedHelp: These values are locked. Choose Custom to create a detached configuration.
sulfurCube.controls.damageArgumentHelp: The nonnegative damage value passed to knockback; this is not necessarily health lost.

sulfurCube.attack.trace.title: Knockback Sequence
sulfurCube.attack.trace.intro: The summary values explain how the selected attack is resolved; they are not separate steps. Only the numbered calls form the ordered sequence. Each call transforms and scales launch power, clamps its components, and adds its velocity to the preceding result.
sulfurCube.attack.trace.healthDamageAppl: Health damage applied to absorbed cube
sulfurCube.attack.trace.yaw: Player yaw used by extra call

sulfurCube.power.title: Power Space
sulfurCube.power.subtitle: How aim and height angle determine launch power.
sulfurCube.power.caveat: This diagram shows internal power components, not velocity. To produce the velocity vector, the game scales the power by damage and knockback resistance, clamps its horizontal and vertical components, applies the final output factors, and directs the horizontal result away from the attacker. The resulting vector is then added to the cube's existing velocity.
sulfurCube.power.svgDescription: A diagram showing the selected base power, vertical aim transfer, feet-elevation rotation, and component-ratio cap inside the horizontal and vertical power axes.
sulfurCube.power.stages.aimHelpBefore: Vertical aim redistributes power between the two components using
sulfurCube.power.stages.elevationHelpBef: Relative attacker-feet elevation rotates the aim-adjusted vector by
sulfurCube.power.stages.cappedHelp: The height-adjusted vector is capped by the archetype values.

sulfurCube.readout.provenanceBehavior: Knockback and repeated uniform-floor motion are derived from locally decompiled game code.
sulfurCube.readout.provenanceData: Resolved cube properties, dimensions, and uniform-floor profiles are derived from game data and runtime initialization; Custom mode clearly separates reader-edited cube values.
sulfurCube.readout.standardMath: Calculations use audited JE 26.3 float boundaries, Minecraft's quantized sine table, and source-relevant aim conversion while retaining Java double precision for positions and stored Motion.
